headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, large marketing text, hero sections, dashboard widget titles
headings.style: Bold, tight tracking, editorial sharpness. Avoid regular weights for major headings.

body.usage: Body text, paragraphs, data tables, UI labels, small details
body.style: Clean, highly readable, neutral to balance the bold headings. Slight tracking on uppercase labels.

rules: NEVER use Inter, Space Grotesk, Roboto, or standard defaults.
Use uppercase labels (tracking-widest, text-xs) for subheadings/categories (e.g., 'WEEK 12', 'GRAMMAR FOCUS').
Avoid gray gradients. Use flat, bold color blocks.
Lime green is for primary actions, active states (like current week), and sharp accents.
Dashboard cards MUST be white or off-white (#FFFFFF / #FAFAFA) sitting on a deep black (#0A0A0A) background canvas for an editorial magazine feel.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: White cards on black backgrounds. Add sharp 1px borders (border-black on light elements, border-lime on active elements).
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp (rounded-none) or very subtle (rounded-sm/rounded-md maximum). No overly bubbly rounded corners (avoid rounded-2xl+ on cards).
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle SVG noise/grain texture overlay specifically to the black background areas (hero section, dark empty states) to give a tactile, premium editorial feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky headers. Example: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/70 border-b border-zinc-800.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_bento: Use dense bento-box layouts for the syllabus generator overview. 32-week timeline should feel like an editorial table of contents.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8 on white cards so the typography has maximum breathing room. Avoid cramped layouts.
grids_and_layouts.timeline: The 32-week syllabus should use a horizontal scrolling strip or a sharp CSS grid matrix. The 'current week' must auto-highlight using the lime green accent (bg-[#A6E22E] text-black) and an assertive 2px border.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text and tables. Limit center-alignment to hero titles only.

components.general: Use Shadcn UI components but heavily override their defaults to match the sharp, editorial aesthetic.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or completely sharp (rounded-none). Primary buttons must be solid #A6E22E with black text. Hover state: slight lift (-translate-y-[1px]) and shadow-lg shadow-lime-400/20.
components.cards: bg-white text-black border border-zinc-200. No heavy dropshadows, rely on the stark color contrast against the black app shell.
components.forms: Inputs should have sharp borders. Focus states must ring with #A6E22E.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Use Framer Motion for subtle page transitions (fade and slide-up).
motion.lists: Use stagger animation on the 32-week syllabus timeline items so they cascade into view smoothly.
motion.rules: Disable all animations if prefers-reduced-motion is active. Keep transitions under 0.3s for speed.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the lime green (#A6E22E) vs white background maintains > 3:1 for large UI components, or use dark text over lime green.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="syllabus-generate-btn"`, `data-testid="week-4-card"`).
accessibility.focus: Always use focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#A6E22E] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#0A0A0A] for accessibility.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind CSS and ensure the color palette (black, white, zinc-900, zinc-100, and lime-400/#A6E22E) is set up in tailwind.config.js.
Add 'Clash Display' and 'Satoshi' fonts (via CDN or local) and set them as default sans families in Tailwind.
Use standard JS/JSX components, NOT TSX. Ensure all file extensions and imports reflect this.
Create a marketing Landing Page and a separate Dashboard layout.
The Dashboard shell (sidebar/topbar background) MUST be black/dark-zinc, while the main content area/cards MUST be stark white for extreme editorial contrast.
Build the 32-week syllabus generator page using a bento grid or timeline. The 'Current Week' must dynamically highlight based on standard school calendar.
Ensure PDF export functionality is considered in the UI (e.g., dedicated 'Export PDF' button on lesson detail pages).
Implement JWT auth mockup and onboarding flow capturing teacher profile data.
Use Shadcn UI for dropdowns, dialogs, and selects, but strip any 'default SaaS' soft shadows and apply the sharp, high-contrast visual rules.
DO NOT use raw HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn components.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs only.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (sharp corners or pill-shaped) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use standard icon libraries (Lucide/Phosphor).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
